ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform
ops.newText: For 90 days after delivery, each Deliverable will conform

ops.text: Vendor further warrants under this Section 19.2 that the Services generally will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, that software will conform to its documentation for 12 months after delivery, and that Services will conform to their documentation for 90 days after performance.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Deliverable conformance window from fifteen to 90 days and removed the "materially" qualifier, and added our standard professional and workmanlike standard for the Services generally together with 12-month software and 90-day Services conformance periods under the same Section, so the existing repair, replacement, and refund remedy in Section 19.4 continues to apply. A fifteen-day window expires with acceptance testing and leaves us no remedy for defects appearing in productive use.
proposal.summary: Set unqualified 90-day Deliverable conformance and add professional and workmanlike Services performance plus 12-month software and 90-day Services conformance warranties under Section 19.2
